request.query:
query Environments($projectId: String!) {
  environments(projectId: $projectId) {
    ...EnvironmentFields
    __typename
  }
}

fragment EnvironmentFields on Environment {
  id
  projectId
  name
  ownerId
  createdAt
  serviceIds
  databaseIds
  keyValueIds
  envGroupIds
  protectedStatus
  networkIsolationEnabled
  ipAllowList
  ipAllowListEntries {
    cidrBlock
    description
    __typename
  }
  ipAllowListProxiedDomains
  __typename
}
